headline: Up to $220,000,000 in bonds for a new high school, plus a Teamsters Local 251 contract and pay rate ordinance.
summary: The council will consider up to $220,000,000 in bonds to finance a new high school and school facilities. It will also consider a labor contract and a pay rate ordinance for Teamsters Local 251.
items: Pre-council: appointment of Nicki Kent to the Library Board
Pre-council: appointment of Monika Zuluaga to the PRA
Consent correspondence A: Patricia L. Whitford, Interim Exeter Town Clerk, requests support in reviewing and responding to the 2025 Affordable Housing Laws
Consent correspondence B: Mark E. Amesbury on unregistered vehicles
Consent correspondence C: City Clerk letter to Carpionato Group on the Narragansett Park Plaza Project (pre-council)
Consent correspondence D: Acting Director of Public Works response on traffic signs on Rice Street

Consent correspondence E: City Solicitor on Firetruck Manufacturer Antitrust Litigation legal services agreement, to be referred to the Finance Committee, Committee on Claims and Pending Suits, and Committee of the Whole
Consent correspondence F: Public Works Department on ending the agreement for e-scooters and e-bikes with Bird Scooters
Mayor's appointment of Nicki Kent to the Public Library Board of Trustees, term expiring the 1st Monday in January 2030, for confirmation
Mayor's appointment of Monika P. Zuluaga to the Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency, term expiring September 12, 2031, for confirmation

Resolution authorizing up to $220,000,000 in general obligation bonds, notes and other evidences of indebtedness for a new high school and school facilities, subject to state housing aid share of not less than 83.7% and reduced by any School Building Authority Capital Fund grant
Ratification of the Collective Bargaining Agreement between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket Water Supply Board, July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, with Finance Committee recommendation for approval

Ordinance repealing and replacing the schedule of pay rates for Local 251 in Section §88-12 of the Code of Ordinances (Teamsters – 2026-2029), for first passage, with Finance Committee recommendation for approval
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor – Temporary Council Chambers
